objects.name: Analytic 2110
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a process setting LD_PRELOAD before launching an Industrial Control System (ICS) service binary, or writing to /etc/ld.so.preload, where the injected library path is not part of the vendor's package manifest. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.
